options.name: apiKey
options.detail: Project API key. Must be present. Official SDKs accept tal_pk_ or tal_sk_ depending on the surface.

options.name: url
options.detail: Ingest origin. Leave unset on Talaria Cloud; the SDK derives https://ingest-<cell>.newtalaria.com from the key.

options.name: release
options.detail: Release name. Omit in CI and the SDK may send <ref>@<shortsha>.

options.name: commitSha
options.detail: Optional commit SHA used when resolving the release identity.

options.name: environment
options.detail: Accepted for compatibility; the API key decides the environment. Not stored or sent.

options.name: sampleRate
options.detail: Error sample rate, clamped to 0–1.

options.name: maxBatchSize
options.detail: Maximum events per flush.

options.name: flushIntervalMs
options.detail: Flush interval in milliseconds.

options.name: defaultIntegrations
options.detail: Install the default integrations.

options.name: userId
options.detail: Default user id attached to events.

options.name: tags
options.detail: Default tags (string map).

options.name: httpTimeoutSeconds
options.detail: HTTP timeout for ingest requests.

options.name: minLevel
options.detail: Minimum log severity the SDK keeps.

options.name: enforceDefaultLevel
options.detail: When true, the default minLevel cannot be lowered by a logger preset.

options.name: loggers
options.detail: Per-logger presets.

options.name: beforeSend
options.detail: Callback that may drop or edit an event before send.

options.name: ignoreErrors
options.detail: Error patterns the SDK drops.

options.name: ignoreUrls
options.detail: URL patterns the SDK ignores.

options.name: platform
options.detail: Wire platform field: dart or flutter.

options.name: storage
options.detail: Optional identity storage override.
